en.title: Three layers of tokens

steps.n: What exists. blue-600, space-4, size-18. Never referenced by components.

Rare exceptions. button-bg-pressed. Each one prompts a question.

zh.title: 令牌的三层结构

用来做什么。text-primary、surface-raised、danger。契约本身，对比度在构建时检查。
少见的例外。button-bg-pressed。每一个都该引出一个问题。

en.title: Measure first, then automate
en.caption: The first project builds the measure. Every later project is judged against it.

steps.n: Agree in writing what a good result looks like.
Four to six weeks of the real number, from existing systems.
Highest volume, lowest baseline.
Same measure. If it moved, grow it. If not, stop.

zh.title: 先测量，再自动化
zh.caption: 第一个项目建立衡量标准，之后每个项目都用它来评判。

steps.n: 书面约定好的结果长什么样。
用四到六周，从现有系统里取得真实数字。
量最大、基线最差的那一步。
用同一个指标衡量。动了就扩大，没动就停。

en.title: A retrieval pipeline
en.caption: Most retrieval failures are search failures. Measure whether the right passage was found before judging the model's answer.

steps.n: From a user, with who they are and what they may read.
Keyword and vector together, filtered by permission and date.
A handful of chunks from the current source documents.
The model answers from the passages and cites them.

zh.title: 一条检索管线
zh.caption: 大多数检索失败其实是搜索失败。在评判模型回答之前，先衡量有没有找到正确段落。

steps.n: 来自用户，并附带他是谁、有权读什么。
关键词与向量结合，按权限和日期过滤。
从当前源文档中取出的少量片段。
模型基于段落作答，并给出引用。

en.title: What a roadmap owes the board
en.caption: A roadmap earns its place on the agenda only when it answers all three.

items.n: Systems retired, processes removed, contracts not renewed — with dates.

items.t: What starts, and how will we know?
items.n: An outcome for every initiative, today's value, and the target.

items.t: What does it cost to be wrong?
items.n: The first checkpoint, what will be known by then, and what will have been spent.

zh.title: 路线图欠董事会的三个答案
zh.caption: 只有三个问题都回答了，路线图才配占用董事会议程。

items.n: 要退役的系统、要取消的流程、不再续签的合同——附日期。

items.t: 开始什么，怎么知道成了？
items.n: 每个项目的结果指标、今天的数值和目标。
第一个检查点、届时会知道什么、那时已花了多少钱。

en.title: Four rules for a quiet interface
en.caption: Restraint is a system: each rule protects the emphasis budget for the moment something really needs attention.

items.n: Usually the primary action or the current selection.
Hierarchy from size, weight and whitespace.
Red means wrong. Nothing else may use it.
Movement shows where things came from and went.

zh.title: 安静界面的四条规则
zh.caption: 克制是一套体系：每条规则都在为真正需要注意的那一刻保留强调的预算。

items.t: 一个强调色，只做一件事
items.n: 通常是主操作或当前选中项。

items.t: 用字体和留白，而不是方框
items.n: 层级来自字号、字重和空白。
红色意味着出错，别处都不许用。
动效说明元素从哪来、到哪去。

en.title: Strict at the edges, plain in the middle
en.caption: Types earn most at boundaries. Inside the application, simple named types that anyone can read beat clever ones.

steps.n: Validated at runtime. Precise types generated from the schema or API definition.
Plain, named interfaces and unions a junior developer can read aloud.
The same generated types, so every consumer agrees with the producer.

zh.title: 边缘严格，中间朴素
zh.caption: 类型在边界处回报最高。应用内部，人人读得懂的简单命名类型胜过巧妙的类型。

steps.n: 运行时校验。精确类型从表结构或 API 定义生成。
朴素、有名字的接口和联合类型，初级开发者也念得出来。
使用同一套生成类型，让每个消费者与生产者一致。

en.title: The evaluation loop
en.caption: Every bad answer becomes a case in the suite, so the suite grows toward the ways the feature actually fails.

zh.title: 评测循环
zh.caption: 每一个糟糕的回答都会变成评测集里的一个用例，评测集因此朝着功能真实的失败方式生长。

items.t: 在 CI 中运行评测

en.title: Replace first, or fix first
en.caption: If most root causes are data and process, fixing them first pays back sooner — and makes any later migration shorter.

rows.a: After go-live, often 18 months or more
Customised to match the old ones

zh.title: 先换，还是先修
zh.caption: 如果大多数根因在数据和流程，先修好它们回报更快——日后真要迁移也会更短。

rows.a: 上线之后，往往 18 个月以上

rows.b: 每一项改进都保留下来

en.title: How a reconciliation agent works
en.caption: Rules first, model second, person last: the agent's job is to hand people only the cases that need judgement.

steps.n: Bank lines, invoices and remittances left after the period closes.
Exact amounts, references and known supplier aliases.
Reads remittance emails, spots split payments and name variants.
Confident match · needs a glance · unresolved, for a person.

zh.title: 对账智能体如何工作
zh.caption: 先规则、后模型、最后是人：智能体的任务，是只把需要判断的案例交给人。

steps.n: 期末关账后剩下的银行流水、发票和汇款。
金额完全一致、参考编号、已知供应商别名。
读汇款邮件，识别拆分付款和名称变体。
高置信匹配 · 需看一眼 · 无法解决，交给人。

en.title: Where to spend AI security effort
en.caption: The dangerous combination is a feature that reads content outsiders can write and can act or send data out.
en.yLabel: Can act or send data out

q.n: Trusted inputs, real powers. Standard access control applies.
Injected instructions can cause harm. Least privilege, human approval, guarded exits.
Internal drafting and summarising of trusted material.
Untrusted inputs, no powers. Keep answers from leaking between users.

zh.title: AI 安全投入应该花在哪里
zh.caption: 危险的组合，是一个既读取外人可写的内容、又能执行操作或向外发送数据的功能。
zh.yLabel: 能执行操作或向外发数据

q.n: 输入可信，权限真实。常规访问控制即可。
注入的指令能造成伤害。最小权限、人工批准、守住出口。
对可信材料做内部起草和总结。
输入不可信，但没有权限。防止回答在用户之间泄漏。

en.title: Loading a rich layer responsibly

区块离开或标签页隐藏时释放 GPU。

en.title: Large hosted model or small model you run
en.caption: Neither wins everywhere. Small models win on narrow, high-volume, privacy-sensitive work; large ones on open-ended tasks.

rows.a: To the provider, under their terms

zh.title: 大型托管模型，还是自己运行的小模型
zh.caption: 没有哪一种处处占优。窄任务、大调用量、隐私敏感的工作，小模型胜出；开放式任务，大模型胜出。

en.title: The two-week diagnostic
en.caption: Fixed fee, fixed length, and a plan that stands on its own whether or not we are hired again.

points.n: Systems, data, invoices and the work as people describe it.
One technical, one organisational, one financial.
Steps that each pay off on their own, with measures.

zh.title: 两周诊断
zh.caption: 固定费用、固定周期，产出的计划无论之后是否找我们，都能独立成立。

points.n: 系统、数据、发票，以及一线人员描述的工作。
一个技术、一个组织、一个财务。
每一步都能独立见效，并附衡量标准。
一个建议，包括“先什么都别动”。

en.title: Where the break is caught
en.caption: A contract moves the check to the producer's build, so a breaking change fails their pull request instead of someone else's dashboard.

zh.title: 故障在哪里被发现
zh.caption: 契约把检查移到生产方的构建里，破坏性改动会让他们自己的合并请求失败，而不是让别人的看板出错。

rows.a: 几天后某个看报表的人

en.title: How long motion should take
en.caption: Guideline durations. Most transitions land between 150 and 250 milliseconds; beyond about 400, users read motion as slowness.

zh.caption: 参考时长。大多数过渡落在 150 到 250 毫秒之间；超过约 400 毫秒，用户会把动效当成慢。

en.title: How this site is built
en.caption: The work is done once at build time, not on every visit. Nothing runs on a server when a page is read.

steps.n: JSON and Markdown, in English and Chinese.
About a second. Refuses to finish if a translation is missing.
Every page written ahead of time, plus the sitemap.
Served from close to the reader, with nothing to compute.

zh.title: 这个网站是怎么构建的
zh.caption: 工作在构建时做一次，而不是每次访问都做。读者打开页面时，服务器上什么都不运行。

steps.n: JSON 与 Markdown，中英文各一份。
约一秒。缺任何一篇翻译就拒绝完成。
每个页面都提前写好，外加站点地图。
从离读者最近的地方发出，无需计算。

en.title: A passkey migration that strands no one
en.caption: Staff go first because they are the highest-value targets and the easiest group to support.

points.n: Offer a passkey after sign-in. Measure uptake.
New accounts start with a passkey; password is the fallback.
Admins and staff with customer-data access.
Two working passkeys? Offer to remove the password.

zh.title: 一次不让任何人掉队的通行密钥迁移
zh.caption: 员工先行，因为他们是价值最高的攻击目标，也是最容易提供支持的人群。

points.n: 登录后提供创建入口，衡量采用率。
新账户从通行密钥开始，密码作后备。
管理员和能访问客户数据的员工。
有两个可用密钥？提出移除密码。

en.title: The four signals, per service
en.caption: Put all four for every service on one screen. It is the dashboard the team opens when someone says the site feels slow.

items.n: Requests per minute. A sudden drop is often the first sign of an outage.
The share of requests that fail. Watch the rate, not the count.
The slow end — the 95th percentile — not the average.
How close the busiest resource is to its limit.

zh.title: 每个服务的四个信号
zh.caption: 把每个服务的四个信号放在同一块屏幕上。有人说网站有点慢时，团队打开的就是它。

items.n: 每分钟请求数。突然下降往往是故障的第一个信号。
失败请求的比例。看比率，不看次数。
看慢的一端——第 95 百分位——而不是平均值。
最繁忙的资源离上限还有多远。

en.title: Anatomy of a prompt that holds up
en.caption: Read it aloud as if briefing a new colleague. If a thoughtful person would know exactly what to do, the specification is good.

items.n: One sentence: what the model is asked to do.
Who the output is for and what they will do with it.
Question and documents clearly marked as material.
Exact fields and values where software reads it.
Two or three short examples of excellent output.
Ask, say it doesn't know, or hand to a person.
Topics to decline, actions never to take.

zh.title: 一个站得住的提示词的结构
zh.caption: 像给新同事做交代一样把它读出来。如果一个认真的人能准确知道该做什么，这份规格说明就是好的。

items.n: 一句话：要模型做什么。
输出给谁看，他们会拿它做什么。
问题和文档明确标记为材料。
由软件读取时，给出精确字段和取值。
两三个优秀输出的简短示例。
提问、说不知道，或交给人。
要婉拒的话题、绝不执行的操作。

en.title: A design system sized for a small team
en.caption: A component enters the system only when a second screen needs it. That rule keeps it small enough to maintain part-time.

items.n: Dialog or new page, how errors are written, what each colour means.
List, detail and form. Most new screens are one of these.
Button, input, table, dialog, tabs, empty state and the rest.
Colour, spacing, type, radius and motion as named values.
Keyboard, focus and screen-reader behaviour you don't build yourself.

zh.title: 为小团队定制的设计系统
zh.caption: 只有当第二个屏幕需要某个组件时，它才进入系统。这条规则让系统小到可以兼职维护。

items.n: 对话框还是新页面、错误信息怎么写、每种颜色代表什么。
列表、详情和表单。大多数新屏幕都是其中之一。
按钮、输入框、表格、对话框、标签页、空状态等。
颜色、间距、字体、圆角和动效，都是有名字的值。

items.t: 具备无障碍能力的基础库
items.n: 键盘、焦点和读屏行为，不必自己从头做。

en.title: Replacing a system one slice at a time
en.caption: Each slice moves behind the routing layer when the new version agrees with the old. The old system shrinks until it can be switched off.

zh.title: 一块一块地替换一个系统
zh.caption: 当某一块的新版本与旧版本结果一致，它就被切到路由层之后。旧系统不断缩小，直到可以关掉。

rows.t: 第 3 个月：第一块上线

en.title: Match the controls to the risk
en.caption: Three tiers keep everyday use easy and put scrutiny where it matters: customer data and decisions about people.

items.n: Approved tools. No further review.
Business data terms. A person reviews the output.
Assessment before use, logging and a named owner.

zh.title: 按风险匹配管控
zh.caption: 三个层级让日常使用保持简单，把审查放在真正要紧的地方：客户数据和关于人的决定。

items.t: 客户数据、关于人的决定
items.n: 使用前评估，保留日志，指定负责人。

en.title: Carrying uncertainty in the interface
en.caption: The model sounds equally sure when it is right and when it is wrong, so the interface has to show which is which.

rows.b: Each point linked to its source passage

Draft shown, changes highlighted, easy to edit
Captured and fed back as new cases

被记录下来，变成新用例

en.caption: Most business websites sit on the left. Only the top right genuinely needs a full client-side application.

en.title: What AI coding tools changed
en.caption: Producing code got cheaper. Deciding what to build, checking it and running it for years did not — and that is where the value has moved.

zh.caption: 产出代码变便宜了。决定做什么、检验它、运行它很多年并没有——价值正是移到了这里。

items: 理清真实世界的数据和规则
